newsitem.title: USA: US Airways to pay all preferred dividends.
newsitem.headline: US Airways to pay all preferred dividends.

text.p: US Airways Group Inc said on Wednesday it will pay all dividends currently outstanding on all its preferred stock, totaling $81.4 million.

US Airways since September 1994 had been prohibited from paying dividends on its preferred stock because under Delaware law it did not have a net capital surplus. Partial payments resumed in July 1996, and now the company plans to pay all dividends accrued but previously unpaid.

The company will make an immediate $34.8 million payment to clear arrearages on its senior preferred stock, series A, F and T. US Airways also said it will pay $46.6 million on April 17 to holders of series B stock as of April 7.
The company also declared regular quarterly dividend payments of $8.3 million on its series A preferred shares and $4.7 million on series B, payable May 15 to holders of record as of May 5.
